sectors.trend: Miners under pressure as ASX hits three-month low; Chinese growth slowdown weighs on iron ore/coal demand. Offsetting positives: record gold grades (Aguia), rare earth discovery (Barkly NT), coal demand resilience, Auric WA plant acceleration.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face headwinds from China demand fears. Gold (GOLD.AX, NGX.AX) and rare earths (LRE.AX, BLY.AX) offer relative strength. Coal (BRL.AX, WDS.AX) supported by 'demise exaggerated' thesis.

sectors.trend: Banks fall on rising yields and credit stress. Bathla insolvency storm, private credit concerns, and mortgage stress on young borrowers raise NPL fears. Rising 10-year yield pressures valuations.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face margin compression risk from credit cycle deterioration. Rising rates support NIM but credit losses may offset. Watch ASX 200 Financials (^AX5J) for divergence.

sectors.trend: Oil jumps on supply concerns; diesel prices spike; east-coast port fuel supply crunch. Green hydrogen policy criticised as wasteful. Coal demand resilient.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, BRL.AX, SXG.AX benefit from oil/diesel strength. Woodside (WDS.AX) and Santos (STO.AX) supported by LNG pricing. Green hydrogen names face policy risk.

sectors.trend: Cue and Veronika Maine collapse signals deep consumer weakness. Price sensitivity rising. Wage stagnation ('pay rise you didn't get') squeezes discretionary spend.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WBC.AX (retail arms), and consumer discretionary names under pressure. Defensive staples (WOW.AX, CBA.AX) preferred. Watch retail sales data.

sectors.trend: Anthropic $31bn QLD datacentre deal signals major capex cycle. AI infrastructure buildout accelerates. Qualcomm AI datacentre foothold noted.
sectors.implications: Local infrastructure and datacentre REITs benefit. CSL.AX (healthcare tech) and ASX-listed datacentre plays gain. Long-term structural tailwind for tech infrastructure.

sectors.trend: Bathla collapse triggers construction/property insolvency wave. Housing Trust tenant issues highlight sector stress. Mortgage stress pressures residential demand.
sectors.implications: Property and construction REITs (VCG.AX, DGL.AX) face credit and occupancy risk. Residential REITs pressured by negative equity dynamics.

China demand deterioration threatening Australian commodity export revenue
Australian credit cycle stress: Bathla insolvency, private credit, mortgage pressure
Energy supply crunch: diesel/fuel logistics disruption at east-coast ports
Consumer confidence erosion: brand collapses, wage stagnation, price sensitivity
AI infrastructure super-cycle: $31bn QLD datacentre, global AI capex
Commodity diversification: gold, rare earths, coal resilience vs iron ore weakness
Superannuation and retirement policy reform debate

Diversify away from iron ore exposure; rotate into gold, rare earths, and domestic-demand sectors

risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid construction/property-linked credit; monitor bank NPL disclosures; favour large-cap banks with strong capital buffers

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Energy supply crunch / diesel price spike
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor logistics cost pass-through; favour energy producers over consumers of fuel
Reduce discretionary consumer exposure; favour staples (WOW.AX, CBA.AX)

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure in 1–3 month window. Three-month low breached; Fed hike risk and 10-year yield surge cap upside. Banks and miners lead declines. Oil/diesel supply crunch adds inflationary pressure. Bathla insolvency contagion may spill into construction and property sectors. Expect volatility around Fed decisions.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive if RBA pivots on inflation and China stabilises. AI infrastructure capex ($31bn QLD datacentre), gold/rare earths discovery pipeline, and coal demand resilience provide structural support. However, credit cycle stress, consumer weakness, and superannuation reform uncertainty cap recovery. ASX 200 likely range-bound until rate clarity emerges.
